name: Sugimoto Akira
source:
The protagonist's underclassman.
She takes care of the rabbits bred at school alongside [url=/c42962]Nakamura Yuuri[/url].
Debilitatingly shy and withdrawn, she had been ignored and ostracized within the school until Yuuri took her under her wing.
She opens her heart to Yuuri only and clings to her at all times.
